title: Let the reviewer run go test, gofmt, slicer show, and slicer goals in the foreground without an approval prompt.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-220113-e6de, project ork, item S396:
Let the reviewer run go test, gofmt, slicer show, and slicer goals in the foreground without an approval prompt.
Evidence: Done when says a command that needs approval ends the run, and that rg, slicer, and test commands stay unverified, so this review could not run the slice Check.

Merged S413 (run ork-20261117-215731-f05c, item S397): in a plan-mode review, allow slicer goals, slicer list and go test without a prompt; that review traced the five tests and did not run them.

Evidence (checked 2026-11-18):

- Both reviewers were Grok rows. `ork show ork-20261117-220113-e6de reviewer-2.md` opens with "Plan mode and the approval rule kept `go test`, `gofmt`, `slicer`, and `rg` from running." The "approval rule" is the Grok-only Done-when text (`internal/engine/brief.go:251-255`): "rg, slicer and test commands remain unverified" and "A command that needs approval ends the run".
- A Grok read-only role gets `--permission-mode plan` and no `--allow` rule (`internal/agent/grok/grok.go:84-85`); the daemon passes `req.Allowlist`, which is empty for a read-only role (`internal/daemon/runner.go:265`; `internal/engine/engine_test.go:225-228`). `TestGrokArgsKeepRuledOutFlagsAndReadOnlyUnchanged` asserts no `--allow` in plan mode (`internal/agent/grok/grok_test.go:282-298`).
- S305's owner interview (2026-11-07, note on S305) says: "Reviewer, gate and spec-check roles on Grok get --allow rules for their read-only test and slicer commands in plan mode", from S274 relay evidence that a Grok reviewer in plan mode with `--allow 'Bash(go test*)'`, `go vet`, `gofmt`, `slicer show`, `slicer goals` rules ran them and returned a real review. The note asks for an adj record first; none exists (`adj check roles.grok-read-only-allow`: not found). S305 itself left read-only roles in plan mode.
- ork already has the read-only list a claude-local read-only role and a cloud UI pass get (`engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`, `internal/engine/perm.go:20-34`): git read forms, `slicer show|goals|list|deps|find`, `adj show|check`, `go test`, `go vet`, `gofmt -l`.
- Grok rows are held out from 2026-12-07 (adj 380, `vendors.grok-cutover`), so this helps for about three weeks.

Open owner question: `roles.grok-read-only-allow` (record the S305 interview answer, and whether to build it before the cutover). The steps below assume the answer is "plan mode plus --allow rules from the read-only list".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/agent/grok/grok.go:80-90` (`Args`: plan mode plus `--allow` rules for a read-only role)
- `internal/agent/grok/grok_test.go:282-298` (`TestGrokArgsKeepRuledOutFlagsAndReadOnlyUnchanged`)
- `internal/daemon/runner.go:258-266` (`grokRunner.Run`: a read-only Grok role gets `engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()`)
- `internal/daemon/runner_test.go`
- `internal/engine/brief.go:250-256` (`doneWhen`: the Grok plan-mode text names the forms that run)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go:1113-1130` (`TestGrokReadOnlyDoneWhenNamesTheFormsThatRun`)
- `docs/design.md` (Grok read-only roles)
- `docs/guide.md` (what a Grok reviewer can run)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestGrokReadOnlyRoleGetsReadOnlyAllowRules` in `internal/agent/grok/grok_test.go`: `Spec{ReadOnly: true, Allowlist: []string{"Read", "Bash(go test*)", "Bash(slicer show*)", "Edit"}}.Args()` holds `--permission-mode plan`, `--allow Bash(go test*)` and `--allow Bash(slicer show*)`, and no `search_replace`, `write` or `dontAsk`. Red today: plan mode passes no `--allow` (`internal/agent/grok/grok.go:84-85`).
- `TestGrokArgsKeepRuledOutFlagsAndReadOnlyUnchanged`: its read-only half now expects the Bash rules and still no write rule and no `dontAsk`. Red today for the same reason.
- `TestGrokRunnerReadOnlyRoleSendsTheReadOnlyList` in `internal/daemon/runner_test.go`: a fake grok round for a read-only reviewer request receives `Allowlist` equal to `engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()`; a write role still receives `req.Allowlist`. Red today: the request's empty list is passed (`internal/daemon/runner.go:265`).
- `TestGrokReadOnlyDoneWhenNamesTheFormsThatRun` in `internal/engine/brief_test.go`: for a Grok read-only role the checklist names `go test`, `go vet`, `gofmt -l`, `slicer show`, `slicer goals` and `slicer list` as forms that run, keeps "one command per call", and no longer says "slicer and test commands remain unverified". Red today: it says they remain unverified (`internal/engine/brief.go:252`).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Per the owner's answer to `roles.grok-read-only-allow`. For the assumed answer: `grokRunner.Run` sets the spec's `Allowlist` to `engine.LocalReadOnlyAllowlist()` when `req.ReadOnly`, as `claudeRunner.Run` does for claude-local (`internal/daemon/runner.go:41-46`).
3. `grok.Spec.Args`: for a read-only role keep `--permission-mode plan` and add one `--allow` per `Bash(...)` entry of the allowlist; never a `write` or `search_replace` rule in plan mode.
4. `doneWhen`: replace the Grok plan-mode sentence with one that names the forms that run (from the read-only list) and keeps "one command per call" and the approval warning for any other command.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md` (Grok read-only roles: plan mode with read-only `--allow` rules, the owner's adj record) and `docs/guide.md`. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S415 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- A Grok reviewer, gate, architect, UI pass or spec check runs in plan mode with allow rules for the read-only commands: go test, go vet, gofmt -l, slicer show, goals, list, deps and find, adj show and check, and git read forms.
- No write rule is ever passed in plan mode.
- The Grok read-only brief names the commands that run and no longer says that test and slicer commands stay unverified.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/agent/grok ./internal/daemon ./internal/engine -run 'TestGrokReadOnly|TestGrokArgsKeepRuledOutFlagsAndReadOnlyUnchanged|TestGrokRunnerReadOnlyRoleSendsTheReadOnlyList' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch, message "S415: Grok read-only roles run go test and slicer reads in plan mode".
